status_definitions.verified_available: A dated successful HTTP request to the actual granule/asset, with evidence URL and 2xx response. This is the only status eligible for an as-of check.
status_definitions.expected_available_not_verified: Provider documents expected coverage or latency, but no successful access timestamp is recorded for this granule.
status_definitions.unavailable: A dated, evidenced provider response or explicit product record says this requested asset is not available.
status_definitions.unknown: No qualifying access evidence or reliable expected-availability evidence is recorded. Never eligible as verified.
